verdict.rationale: Fellow publishes a structured per-endpoint API reference at developers.fellow.ai/reference, covering recordings, action items, note agenda writes, authentication, pagination and uploads, plus an llms.txt index. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or offers runnable or try-it examples, and no OpenAPI spec was found at any probed path. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console, runnable code samples, a public OpenAPI spec, and hands-on corroboration.
